description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Mirakl:</strong></p> <p>Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.<br><br>Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).<br><br>With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="http://www.mirakl.com">www.mirakl.com</a>.</p> <p><strong>Mirakl in Numbers:</strong></p> <ul> <li>🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40</li> <li>👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo</li> </ul> <p><strong>Our Values:</strong></p> <p>Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.</p> <p>Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:</p> <ul> <li>💡<strong> Work Hard Together:</strong> Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success</li> <li>🏆 <strong>Get Things Done: </strong>&nbsp;We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results</li> <li>🚀 <strong>Go Above &amp; Beyond:</strong>&nbsp; We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence</li> <li>🎓 <strong>Succeed Through Expertise:</strong> Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture</li> <li>🤝 <strong>Satisfy &amp; Empower Clients:</strong> We're committed to our clients' success</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><h2>Interested in being considered for a future Enterprise Account Executive role at Mirakl?</h2> <p>Tell us a little bit about yourself so we start here first.&nbsp;<strong>This is not a live job opening. </strong>We’re building a talent pool for future opportunities on our US Platform Sales team and will keep your information on file for consideration.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do at Mirakl</strong></p> <ul> <li>Define and execute a territory-based sales strategy to consistently meet and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets.</li> <li>Identify and engage net-new enterprise clients aligned with Mirakl's go-to-market strategy, driving platform adoption across retail and B2B markets.</li> <li>Build and nurture executive-level relationships with VP, EVP and C-suite stakeholders, positioning Mirakl as a transformative platform partner.</li> <li>Own the full sales cycle from initial outreach through&nbsp; to contract signature, while navigating technical, legal and financial complexities with confidence.</li> <li>Drive revenue growth across new logos and existing accounts through strategic upselling and cross-selling, while contributing to Mirakl's market presence and professional network.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What We’re Looking For</strong></p> <p>Experience</p> <ul> <li>8+ years in a closing role in software/SaaS/eCommerce.</li> <li>A consistent track&nbsp; record&nbsp; of exceeding quota and managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales processes.</li> <li>Proven experience selling to Fortune 500 companies and engaging with C-suite executives.</li> </ul> <p>Skills</p> <ul> <li>Strong executive presence and the ability to influence stakeholders at the highest levels.</li> <li>Strategic territory-planning skills paired with sharp tactical execution.</li> <li>The ability to compellingly pitch disruptive technology to large enterprises.</li> <li>Confidence navigating long, complex sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders.</li> <li>Willingness and ability to travel as needed.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What Happens Next</strong></p> <ul> <li>Your information will remain on file with our US Talent team for consideration for future Account Executives opportunities.</li> <li>If a relevant role opens and your experience is a strong fit, a recruiter may contact you.</li> <li>All active opportunities are always posted on our <a href="https://www.mirakl.com/company/careers/">Careers Page</a>. If you see a current role that aligns with your experience, we encourage you to apply directly.</li> </ul> <p>Thank you for your interest in Mirakl!</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you’re ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world’s most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.</em></p> <p><em>As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, <a href="https://www.mirakl.com/recruitment-privacy-notice" target="_blank">here</a> in English and <a href="https://www.mirakl.com/fr-FR/recruitment-privacy-notice" target="_blank">here</a> in French.&nbsp;</em></p> <p><em>We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our </em><a href="https://info.mirakl.com/ai-guidelines-for-candidates-and-interviews" target="_blank"><em>AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews</em></a><em>.</em></p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: SAP Integration Architect
description: <h2><strong>About Parloa</strong></h2> <p>Parloa’s mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like <a href="http://booking.com">Booking.com</a>, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>About the role:</strong></h2> <p>As Parloa continues to grow rapidly within the SAP ecosystem, we're hiring an <strong>SAP Integration Architect </strong>to join our SAP Center of Excellence (CoE). This unique role sits at the intersection of enterprise SAP orchestration and high human-touch cutting edge conversational AI. You will be the field-facing SAP SME who architects, builds and deploys technical bridges and extensions between Parloa’s conversational AI platform and the SAP ecosystem, spanning SAP CX and other SAP SaaS applications, SAP BTP and SAP Business AI, as well as digital core systems, such as SAP S/4HANA and ECC.&nbsp;As one of our foundational SAP CoE hires, you will also participate in building and deploying Parloa's global SAP delivery practice from the ground up, creating the reference architectures, accelerators, best practices and playbooks that make Parloa’s SAP integrations repeatable at scale.</p> <h2><strong>Areas of ownership:</strong></h2> <p>This role is a blend of architecture and hands-on delivery and centers on SAP integration and orchestration as the core area of ownership and conversational AI as a secondary skillset.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Own SAP integration and orchestration architectures:</strong> design and architect SAP integration and orchestration solutions spanning Parloa's AI platform, cloud and on-premise SAP estates, and non-SAP applications around digital SAP core.</li> <li><strong>Deliver across the full project lifecycle: </strong>drive<strong> </strong>discovery, build, test, and go-live, by implementing integrations and automation workflows in cloud-native and hybrid environments over SAP state-of-the-art platforms such as SAP BTP (Integration Suite incl. SAP CI, Event Mesh, API Management, Integration Advisor, Open Connectors) and on-demand over legacy ESB such as SAP PI/PO.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Master SAP interfacing technologies:</strong> Apply deep hands-on knowledge of SAP OData and REST APIs, SOAP WebServices, RFMs / BAPIs, and ALE/IDocs, including extensibility, monitoring, troubleshooting, connectivity configuration and performance tuning.</li> <li><strong>Leverage your foundational SAP AI knowledge:&nbsp;</strong>apply your first<strong> </strong>hands-on experience with SAP Business AI and it's underlying components such as SAP AI Core and Launchpad, SAP Joule agents and skills to support AI-powered integration scenarios and extensibility.</li> <li><strong>Lead customer conversations on demand</strong>: Run discovery workshops and architecture discussions as the trusted SAP integration expert.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate across functions when needed</strong>: Work in tandem with Parloa's Agent Architects and FDEs, and provide technical guidance and enablement to non-SAP team members.</li> <li><strong>Contribute to global SAP practice:</strong> Turn field experience and lessons learned into accelerators, reference architectures and playbooks that improve delivery repeatability.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>5+ years of hands-on experience in SAP integration development and architecture incl. technical consulting, and delivering scalable integrations in live enterprise environments.</li> <li>Strong hands-on experience with SAP BTP Integration Suite: analyzing and applying standard integration packages as well as designing, building, and operating end-to-end custom solutions interacting across all SAP IS services, such as SAP CI, Event Mesh, API Management, Open Connectors etc.</li> <li>First experience in the field with SAP’s AI stack (e.g., SAP AI Core, SAP AI Launchpad, SAP Joule) and interoperability standards like MCP</li> <li>Foundational SAP ABAP knowledge and solid Groovy scripting skills</li> <li>Consulting or advisory affinity: experience guiding enterprise customers, partners, or systems integrators through solution discovery, architecture discussions, or implementation trade-offs</li> <li>Project and stakeholder management skills, with passion for meeting milestones and effective communication</li> <li>Entrepreneurial mindset with initiative, results orientation, and the ability to identify opportunities for impact</li> <li>Ability to travel and to be on demand on-site with customers and partners for key moments like discovery workshops, architecture reviews, and go-lives</li> <li>Fluent business English and German is required</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Exposure to Large Language Models (LLMs) and conversational design to craft effective prompts that align with desired outcomes</li> <li>Exposure to customer contact center technologies, telephony and enterprise CX platforms</li> <li>Familiarity with SAP architecture frameworks (Clean Core, ISA-M, Extensibility Framework)</li> <li>Familiarity with the SAP CX and CRM solutions, such as SAP Service Cloud, SAP Sales Cloud etc.</li> <li>Familiarity developing extensions on SAP BTP using CAP is an important, though not core, differentiator</li> <li>Experience integrating non-SAP ERPs (MS Dynamics 365, Oracle NetSuite) and CRM/HCM systems (Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow).</li> <li>Foundational knowledge of a cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and Kubernetes; programming in Python, SQL, or TypeScript/Node.js.</li> <li>Foundational knowledge of SAP data and analytics (SAP BW/4HANA, SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud).</li> <li>Experience working with or for SAP system integrators or within the broader SAP partner ecosystem</li> <li>Experience operating in fast-paced startup or high-growth enterprise software environments.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Our recruiting process:</strong></h2> <p>TA Screen → Hiring Manager Call → Case Study &amp; Expert Interview(s) → Bar Raiser</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><iframe style="display: table; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/P4d-iyx7RQM" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <hr> <p>Parloa is committed to upholding the highest data protection standards for our clients' and employees' data. All our employees are instrumental in ensuring the utmost care, GDPR, and ISO compliance, including ISO 27001, in handling sensitive information.</p> <p>Parloa is an e-verify employer in the USA. <a class="c-link" href="https://www.e-verify.gov/about-e-verify/what-is-e-verify" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.e-verify.gov/about-e-verify/what-is-e-verify" data-sk="tooltip_parent">Please click here to learn more</a>.</p> <p><strong>* </strong><strong>We provide equal opportunities to all qualified applicants regardless race, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, national origin, disability status, socioeconomic background and other characteristics.</strong></p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

define the category narrative for enterprise AI agents at the exact moment the market is being formed.</p> <h2><strong>Areas of ownership:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Go-to-Market Strategy:</strong> Define positioning and messaging for Parloa products, orchestrate product communication plans, and drive cross-functional launches across Product, Marketing, Sales, and CX.</li> <li><strong>Product and Roadmap Alignment:</strong> Partner with Product and Engineering so the roadmap ladders up to the company narrative and GTM plan, and keep prospects, partners, and customers informed at every step.</li> <li><strong>Sales Enablement:</strong> Sharpen how Sales positions the platform through customer use cases, proof points, collateral, training sessions, and competitive differentiators built with our Enablement and Competitive Intelligence teams.</li> <li><strong>Market Awareness and Thought Leadership:</strong> Source content ideas, shape outlines, create and review content, and speak on webinars alongside our Content team, Evangelists, CX team, and executives.</li> <li><strong>Competitive Differentiation:</strong> Establish a deep understanding of the market, customers, and competition, then turn that insight into positioning that separates Parloa from the field.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>6+ years in Product Marketing, or 8+ years in adjacent roles working alongside a PMM team (sales enablement, B2B direct marketing).</li> <li>Experience at an AI company or marketing AI products or capabilities.</li> <li>An excellent writer with samples to prove it.</li> <li>A proven track record supporting enterprise sales teams with storylines, collateral, enablement, and individual deal support.</li> <li>A confident presenter who holds an audience on webinars, at company events, and in Sales training sessions.</li> <li>Ambidextrous across strategy and tactics. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.</p> <p>At Parloa, ownership isn't a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that's evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.</p> <p>We’re a scale-up, having moved beyond our earliest startup phase. But we've kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.</p> <p>Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we're scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><iframe style="display: table; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/P4d-iyx7RQM" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <hr> <p>Parloa is committed to upholding the highest data protection standards for our clients' and employees' data. description: <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>About commercetools</strong></span></h4> <p>Real innovation starts with a strong foundation, and at commercetools, that comes from the perfect balance of our product and our people.</p> <p>Behind every leap forward is a collective of builders, explorers, doers, makers, and problem-solvers. Together they are the engine of commerce innovation today.</p> <p>At commercetools, we power the next era of commerce for our customers. Whether it’s AI-driven solutions that help enterprises make smarter business decisions, bridging digital and physical shopping experiences, or enabling entirely new ways for industries to connect with their customers, we help the world’s most ambitious companies experiment, scale, and grow without limits.</p> <p>Here the best idea wins, not the loudest voice. You will have the tools, trust, and space to not only build the future of commerce, but to build your own.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>About our Customer Success team</strong></span></p> <p>Hello, I am <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/gareth-rea-4b764a21/">Gareth</a>, the Head of Customer Success UK/Ire &amp; Nordics here at commercetools. My team is dedicated to building deep, consultative partnerships within the Enterprise space.</p> <p>Our Customer Success Team is passionate about shaping and scaling an exceptional upmarket customer experience across the Enterprise Segment. We’re thrilled to be hiring our next Senior CSM in EMEA as we continue to grow the team.</p> <p>In this role, you’ll serve as the vital link between our customers and the most modern commerce products on the market. You will partner with our largest and most complex enterprise accounts, from high-growth brands to public companies, focusing on account health, post-sales adoption, and positioning commercetools as a trusted, strategic partner.</p> <p>You’ll work closely with our internal support, product development, and sales teams to pave the best path forward for our clients. Because commercetools is powerful, modern, and highly flexible, you’ll leverage your deep technical understanding, sales affinity, and top-tier communication skills to help major brands architect exceptional commerce workflows and achieve long-term value. Beyond account management, you’ll actively contribute to shaping and growing our Customer Success practice both regionally and globally.</p> <p>If you are ready to drive great solutions for big brands, manage multi-channel customer communications, and thrive in a high-impact role, we’d love to meet you!</p> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Your Impact</strong></span></h4> <ul> <li>Guide enterprise clients in maximizing the value of our agentic commerce architecture, including Composable Commerce, Frontend, and Connect, helping them build metrics</li> <li>Proactively drive account engagements, leading high-impact Strategic Business Reviews (SBRs) to retain clients, boost platform consumption, and accelerate long-term growth</li> <li>Partner closely with Product Management to advocate for customer needs, providing critical feedback to shape the roadmap for our latest product innovations</li> <li>Collaborate seamlessly across working groups, showcasing customer success and driving community engagement</li> <li>Play a pivotal role in refining global Customer Success frameworks, driving internal process improvements, and shaping the department’s long-term operational strategy</li> <li>Act as a recognized domain expert internally and externally, mentoring team members, fostering cross-functional collaboration, and elevating collective CS practice standards</li> </ul> <p><strong><em>This role is hybrid, with three days a week spent in our</em><em> Berlin</em><em>&nbsp;office.&nbsp;</em></strong></p> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What Sets You Apart</strong></span></h4> <ul> <li>5+ Years in High-Touch Tech with proven success in CS, pre-sales, or technical consulting, ideally within navigates C-suite discussions, shapes client strategy, and drives expansion effortlessly</li> <li>A structured, agile approach to managing complex accounts independently and across global, cross-functional squads</li> <li>A collaborative team player ready to thrive in a fast-scaled, international tech culture, willing to travel up to 50% to build high-value client connections</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Nice to Have:&nbsp;</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Additional European language skills</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Our Benefits</strong></span></h4> <p>Because work and life are connected, our benefits are too. We’ve designed them to give you the security, flexibility, and opportunities you need to focus on what matters most.</p> <p>🩺 <strong>Comprehensive health benefits</strong> for you and your dependents, including access to OpenUp for personalized mental health support</p> <p>📚 <strong>Learning and development </strong>opportunities including an annual learning budget, access to self-paced learning platforms and language training, personalized coaching, mentorship, and leadership programs</p> <p>🍼 <strong>Family Leave Plus</strong> gives you additional fully paid weeks of parental leave on top of government-provided leave, so you can spend more time with your new addition</p> <p>📈 <strong>Our equity participation program</strong> allows you to share in our success&nbsp;</p> <p>For more information on our benefits, <a href="https://commercetools.com/careers/our-benefits">visit this page.</a></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Come as you are. raw.title: Founder’s Associate
raw.description:
🏢 Who we are

A team from Germany with the vision to make advanced network security accessible for everyone

We are a software company developing an open source zero-trust network security platform that is both easy to use and affordable for teams of all sizes and budgets. Our mission is grounded in a simple yet powerful belief: secure private networking is a fundamental right of every modern company.

Since our launch on GitHub in 2021, we have gained trust among thousands of companies seeking secure and seamless solutions for connecting remote employees and infrastructure. By replacing traditional centralized VPNs, NetBird has become a trusted choice for modern network security, connecting today hundreds of thousands of users and machines worldwide. Our open source, community-driven approach has been a key driver of our success. We listen to our users, and their input helps us make network security better for everyone.

Want to see what we're working on? Check out our GitHub repo at https://github.com/netbirdio/netbird or https://netbird.io/knowledge-hub

✏️ What you will do

As Founder's Associate at NetBird, you'll work directly with our founders and Chief of Staff as a sparring partner and execution engine on the topics that matter most to the company. This is a high-trust, high-ownership role for someone who wants to see, and shape, how a fast-growing open source startup is built, from strategy to day-to-day execution.

Specifically, you will:

  • Own strategic projects across growth, product, operations, and fundraising end to end, from first analysis to shipped result

  • Help grow the team, from running recruiting operations to winning exceptional people for NetBird

  • Research markets, competitors, and customer needs to identify new opportunities and risks before they become obvious

  • Drive cross-team initiatives and keep Product, Growth, and Engineering aligned on critical company milestones

  • Design and improve the internal processes that keep a scaling company running, and take ownership of whatever matters most right now, from testing new GTM ideas to unblocking the founders

🔎 What we are looking for

We're looking for an exceptional generalist: highly motivated, analytical, and hands-on, with the ambition to help build and scale a tech startup from the inside.

What you bring

  • A track record of excellence and real ownership, for example through top academic results from a top tier university or internships in high-caliber startups, venture capital, investment banking, or strategy consulting

  • You're highly structured, organized, and able to drive multiple topics in parallel without losing your eye for detail

  • You enjoy working with data, building models, and turning insights into action, but also have a hands-on mentality

  • You're comfortable taking a vague problem, defining it, and driving it to a result

🌟 What makes you a great fit

These are the values we work by as a team, and what they mean for this role:

  • Own the outcome: Small team, real scope. You take problems end to end and ship something that works today instead of polishing a plan for weeks.

  • Default to candor: Direct, kind, and specific, whether you're challenging a colleague's assumption or receiving feedback yourself. The best argument wins.

  • Stay close to the user: You don't have to be an engineer, but you're genuinely curious about our product and the open source community behind it.

😌 What's in for you

We know that happy and supported team members build the best products. That's why we offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity: everyone at NetBird owns a piece of what we're building

  • Close collaboration with our co-founders: work with them day to day and learn how a startup is really built

  • High impact: your projects directly shape NetBird's trajectory

  • Hybrid setup: a centrally located Berlin office with flexibility for remote days

  • The essentials done well: team lunches, team events, health and fitness programs (e.g., Wellpass), and dinner on us when you're working late

title: Projektentwickler - Ostdeutschland (m/w/d)
description: Q ENERGYs Ziel ist es, eine nachhaltige Welt mit grüner Energie zu ermöglichen. Unsere Unternehmenswerte - Verantwortung, Partnerschaft, Inklusive and "Changemaker" - sind die Grundlage für unser Handeln. Als Europas führender Anbieter von grünen Energielösungen sind wir ein vertrauenswürdiger Partner für das gesamte Spektrum der erneuerbaren Energien. Unser Ziel ist es, die Welt mit Solar-, Wind- und Hybridkraftwerken, innovativen Speicherlösungen und visionären grünen Wasserstoffprojekten neu zu definieren. Begleite uns auf dieser spannenden Reise, um unseren Planeten nachhaltig zu verändern. Für unser Team suchen wir eine engagierte Projektmanager (m/w/d), die die erfolgreiche Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Wind-, PV- und BESS-Projekten von der ersten Standortidee bis zur Genehmigungsreife und Übergabe in die Realisierung verantwortet.   Ziel der Rolle ist es, wirtschaftlich attraktive, genehmigungsfähige und technisch umsetzbare Projekte zu identifizieren und gezielt voranzutreiben. Dabei übernimmst Du die ganzheitliche Steuerung der Projekte sowie die Koordination aller relevanten internen und externen Stakeholder und stellst die Einhaltung von Zeit-, Kosten-, Qualitäts- und Entwicklungszielen sicher. Ihre Aufgaben Projektakquise und Standortentwicklung: Identifikation, Bewertung und Sicherung geeigneter Standorte und Flächen für Wind-, PV- und BESS-Projekte einschließlich Machbarkeitsanalysen und Flächensicherung. Projektentwicklung und Genehmigung: Entwicklung und Optimierung von Projekten, Steuerung der Genehmigungs- und Planungsverfahren sowie Koordination von Gutachtern, Planern, Behörden und weiteren Projektpartnern. Technische und wirtschaftliche Entwicklung: Bewertung von Netzanschlussmöglichkeiten, Projektlayouts und Wirtschaftlichkeit sowie Steuerung von Kosten, Terminen, Risiken und Projektbudgets. Stakeholder- und Projektmanagement: Aufbau und Pflege von Beziehungen zu Grundstückseigentümern, Kommunen, Behörden, Netzbetreibern und Geschäftspartnern sowie Koordination der internen und externen Projektbeteiligten. Projektabschluss und Übergabe: Vorbereitung der Projekte für Finanzierung, Vermarktung, Verkauf oder Übergabe in die Bau- und Realisierungsphase. Requirements Abgeschlossenes Studium oder vergleichbare Qualifikation im technischen oder energiewirtschaftlichen Umfeld. Berufserfahrung in der Projektentwicklung im Bereich erneuerbare Energien, der Netzintegration oder der Netzanschlussplanung. Gute Kenntnisse regulatorischer- und Grundkenntnisse netztechnischer Anforderungen. Analytische, strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise. Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und starkes Schnittstellenmanagement. Deutschkenntnisse auf professionellem Niveau sowie fortgeschrittene Englischkenntnisse werden vorausgesetzt. Benefits Flexibler Arbeitsort:  Du hast die Möglichkeit, remote von zu Hause aus zu arbeiten. Zusätzlich steht dir unser modernes und nachhaltiges Büro in Berlin-Südkreuz zur Verfügung, das eine gute Anbindung und eine angenehme Arbeitsumgebung bietet. IT-Ausstattung:  Wir stellen dir einen Laptop, Monitor, Kopfhörer und, falls erforderlich, ein Diensthandy zur Verfügung. Work-Life-Balance:  Deine Zeit ist wertvoll! Gestalte deine Arbeitszeiten flexibel, damit du persönliche Termine wahrnehmen, früher ins Wochenende starten oder einfach das Leben besser mit der Arbeit in Einklang bringen kannst. Du entscheidest. Spendit Card:  Monatlich  50 € zusätzlich zum Gehalt , die du für dein tägliches Mittagessen nutzen oder unbegrenzt ansparen kannst. Großzügige Urlaubsregelung:  Genieße  31 Urlaubstage  pro Jahr, um dich zu erholen, neue Energie zu tanken und die Welt zu entdecken. Onboarding:  Mit einem strukturierten Onboarding-Prozess sorgen wir für einen reibungslosen Start und begleiten dich von Tag eins an, damit du dich gut aufgehoben fühlst. Betriebliche Altersvorsorge:  Wir leisten einen monatlichen Beitrag von  13,29 €  zu deiner Altersvorsorge. Versicherungsschutz:  Unfall- und Lebensversicherung sind inklusive – für deine Sicherheit und ein gutes Gefühl, sowohl im Job als auch privat. Mitarbeiterrabatte:  Über unser Corporate Benefits-Programm erhältst du exklusive Rabatte auf zahlreiche Marken und Produkte. Firmenwagen:  Falls du berechtigt bist und dein Job es erfordert, steht dir ein Firmenwagen zur Verfügung. Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement:  Deine Gesundheit steht an erster Stelle! Profitiere von unserem Gesundheitsmanagement, inklusive Vorsorgeuntersuchungen, um fit und leistungsfähig zu bleiben. Möchtest du Teil von  Q ENERGY  werden? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! Bitte teile uns dabei deine  Gehaltsvorstellung  sowie dein  frühestmögliches Startdatum  mit. Hinweis:  Wir akzeptieren keine Bewerbungen per E-Mail. Bitte nutze für deine Bewerbung den  „Jetzt bewerben“-Button . Vielen Dank! Bei Fragen steht dir unser Recruiting-Team gerne zur ----- ENERGY  ist ein international tätiges Unternehmen – bei uns arbeiten Menschen aus verschiedenen Nationen, Kulturen und Standorten partnerschaftlich zusammen und tauschen ihre Erfahrungen und Werte in einer offenen und kollegialen Atmosphäre aus. description: Wer wir sind Die Mayflower GmbH baut Individualsoftware mit Fokus auf Generative AI – seit 1998 inhabergeführt. Wir bringen komplette AI-Infrastrukturen in Produktion: Model-Serving, Agent-Gateways, Chat und Voice – direkt in der Umgebung des Kunden. Dich erwartet ein agiles Arbeitsumfeld mit echter Verantwortung und flachen Strukturen – Entscheidungen triffst Du selbst, statt sie durch Freigabeschleifen zu schieben. Wir suchen Dich – jemanden, der AI-Systeme nicht nur konzipiert, sondern ihren Weg in die Produktion aktiv mitverantwortet. Von der Architekturberatung auf C-Level bis zum Produktivbetrieb: Du entwirfst die Lösung und bringst sie mit dem Team in den echten Einsatz. Was dich erwartet Anspruchsvolle Projekte mit LLMs, Agentic RAG und AI-Agent-Frameworks (z. B. LangGraph, PydanticAI, Mastra oder OpenAI Agents SDK) – inklusive Deep-Agent-Architekturen. Du baust Evaluation-Pipelines und Observability (Logging/Tracing mit LangSmith, Langfuse o. Ä.) auf und arbeitest mit modernem MLOps-Stack sowie Vector Databases. Du entwirfst Lösungsarchitekturen für komplexe Kundenvorhaben – mit Security, Compliance, Skalierbarkeit und Datenschutz im Hinterkopf – von der ersten Skizze im Gespräch bis zur konkreten Roadmap. Gemeinsam im Team führst Du Deep-Dive-Calls und Workshops mit Kunden durch und bringst sie in die nächste Projektphase. Du begleitest die Anbahnung neuer Projekte und unterstützt unser Team im Pre-Sales mit technischer Glaubwürdigkeit. title: Senior Program Manager, Customer Experience and Defect Elimination
description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. About the role Every contact that reaches a customer support agent, and every credit issued to customers, represents a defect somewhere in our system. This role exists to help find those defects, trace them to their source, and work with the teams responsible to eliminate them at a systemic level. This is a high impact senior program management role within the EMEA Customer Experience organisation, reporting to the Director of Defect Elimination and Customer Experience. The Senior Program Manager is accountable for turning customer experience signals from Wolt and/or Deliveroo markets into clear, actionable insight, and for driving the resulting fixes through to resolution with partner teams. What you'll be doing You will own the delivery of the defect elimination program across EMEA, including application of the defect driver taxonomy to identify where defect rate concentrates, and where customer outcomes are worst. You will build a clear, prioritised list of issues for partner teams to work through. You will represent the voice of the customer in the rooms where decisions get made about your markets. That means preparing and presenting data in product reviews, weekly/monthly business reviews and planning sessions, so the cost of poor customer experience is concrete and attributable, and so partner teams understand what is being asked of them and why. You will build working relationships with partner teams in engineering, marketplace operations, courier operations, and finance, and you will track the fixes they commit to through to completion. You will feed results back into the program so everyone can see what worked, and to ensure defects are eliminated for good. You will maintain and improve the data infrastructure and reporting that underpins this work, ensuring customer experience insights are credible, available and actionable. Our humble expectations The right person for this role has spent time inside a large-scale customer experience or operations function, and has direct experience translating customer defects through identification, root cause analysis and resolution. They are comfortable working with imperfect data, and they know how to build a credible case when the evidence is directional rather than conclusive. Strong analytical instincts are essential. This person needs to know what questions to ask of the data and whether the answers make sense. Prior exposure to a successful voice of the customer (VoC) program is critical. There is a meaningful cross-functional dimension to the role. This person will spend real time getting other teams to prioritise work that benefits the customer but may compete with other priorities. That requires good judgement, clear communication, and the ability to build trust quickly with people outside their reporting line. The role also requires the ability to drive results in a dynamic and ambiguous landscape. The right person will combine introducing structure and rigor, while being agile and responsive to changing priorities and emerging issues.  This is a high impact and high visibility role, with the opportunity to interact with stakeholders and teams across the full customer lifecycle. The role will also span across 40 EMEA Roo & Wolt markets, meaning there is an opportunity to drive financial and customer experience results at scale. Next steps You will first meet with our Talent Acquisition team to understand role and company fit. Then, you will meet with the Hiring Manager who will talk through your relevant experience and ask you competency based questions that assess your suitability for the role. The third stage is an assignment, where you will be given a business problem to think through, and present back to the team. If successful, there may be a final conversation with a more senior stakeholder. Throughout all stages, you will have plenty of opportunities to ask any questions about the role, team or company. Hi, I'm Erik, CTO of Circonomit. This ad is specific on purpose: you should be able to tell from it whether this is your job.

We build decision infrastructure for industrial companies: our customers model their production, with its capacities, costs and constraints, and we compute the answer to "what should we do?" before the decision is made.

Your mission: scale our data platform for multiple customers and domains. Customer data arrives in many formats from many sources, ERP exports included; it has to land in our system consistently, stay manageable at millions of records, and be fast to query when models and results are on-screen. The product is a data-heavy web app with a math-heavy backend (Python, TypeScript, Solid.js, Postgres, on Cloudflare): your center of gravity is data and infrastructure, but you touch the whole stack. We are looking for a system thinker who wants to shape the architecture.

We will not sugarcoat it: short deadlines, real workload, and a platform that grows while customers already run on it.

What you'll own

  • The data platform end to end: ingestion, storage, and the query paths that keep millions of records fast on screen. You design it, you build it, you run it in production.
  • The platform layer, directly with the CTO: infrastructure, deployments, and the path to production for the whole team.
  • Performance and correctness work in the optimization engine, together with our research engineers.
  • Your features from first line to production: nobody hands you a ticket and waits.

How we work

Small team, short lines of communication, no layers. You own your features end to end: you build them, you ship them to production yourself, you run them.

Feedback runs both ways, and it runs continuously, in daily work and in weekly one-on-ones. We talk as equals. We communicate proactively and flag it early when something isn't working out. Saying no is part of the job.

We like this work, and you'll notice. We review each other's code, and we like being together in the Cologne office, because the fastest conversations still happen in a room.

Requirements

  • 5+ years building production backend or data-intensive systems.
  • Strong Python and solid TypeScript, with the appetite to work in both daily.
  • Analytics-data experience: real SQL depth, plus any of Parquet/Arrow/DuckDB/dbt/warehouse internals.
  • Production PostgreSQL (multi-tenant, migrations, performance).
  • Data pipelines over heterogeneous sources (ERP exports, Excel, CSV) onto object storage (S3 or comparable), built to keep working as customers and formats grow.
  • Distributed systems and API design: typical failure modes, HTTP/auth/caching, sane versioning and error behavior.
  • Engineering craft: design patterns, CI/CD pipelines you set up yourself, prototypes you can throw away.
  • You have worked in a team, not mostly alone, and you know from experience which agile practices carry their weight.
  • You have experience working with Linear, Jira, or a similar project management tool.
  • You communicate proactively, too much rather than too little, and you organize yourself and your work.
  • German at C1 or better, and fluent English. Team life runs in German; code and docs are English.
  • NRW-based (Cologne office), optionally Munich, Stuttgart, Berlin area or else willing to work hybrid. Open to find a way if we fit.

Nice to have: a substantial migration you carried out end to end (system, stack, or data) · telemetry and observability · Cloudflare or comparable serverless infrastructure · frontend experience, ideally with Solid.js or another reactive framework · optimization/OR exposure · manufacturing or ERP data experience.

You are structured and biased for action, and you have shown you play to win wherever life has put you so far.

This role is not for you if you want a clearly defined box, or work handed to you in tickets. We are a small team, pre-Series A: structures and processes are still being built, by us and by you. Priorities shift with customers, and some weeks a deadline bends the plan.

Benefits

  • Impact. You see your results in the real world, fast. The problems are concrete (production plans, capacities, logistics), and customers can measure in euros what your work changed.
  • Ownership. What you build, you ship, and you own it once it runs. No layers between you and production, no approval chain that turns your decision into someone else's.
  • The people next to you. You work directly with the CTO on the platform layer, and with the math and OR team on the optimization engine.
  • Shaping. The processes are still forming, and whoever shows up with a better way of doing things gets to install it. This is a place for system thinkers: the interesting part is seeing how the pieces fit and where they will break. The company is early, and your scope will grow with it.
  • Feedback speed. You will know where you stand. We say things out loud, we adjust, and we expect the same from you.
  • High stakes. Competitive salary and relevant room in the equity package (VSOP) to match your contribution and your career development.
  • The basics. Hardware of your choice · AI tooling budget · sports membership · Deutschland-Ticket.

Process: first conversation, 20 minutes, with me or with the engineer who owns our frontend. Second conversation with the two of us together; this is where the technical questions get deep. Then a hands-on challenge, about three hours of your time, followed by a 45-minute walkthrough where you explain your solution and the decisions behind it. Finally, the team: online first, then in person at the office. Both sides decide. Two to three weeks end to end, and you hear back within days after each step. Before you decide, ask us to put you on a call with someone who will tell you the good, the bad and the ugly.

To apply: skip the cover letter. Tell us about your favorite system you have built, and one decision in it you would reverse today.

"Hustle the day, analyze at night, reinforce something outstanding." Period.

title: Managing Consultant – Data & Analytics (w/m/d)
description: Deine Aufgaben In dieser Rolle berätst und begleitest du unsere Kunden bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung datengetriebener Lösungen und übernimmst dabei Verantwortung für Projekte, Teams und die Kundenbeziehung. Du verbindest fachliche und strategische Fragestellungen mit modernen Data-, Analytics- und AI-Technologien, führst Kundenprojekte von der Konzeption bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden nachhaltige Lösungen und neue Geschäftspotenziale. Du verantwortest die Beratung unserer Kunden im Bereich Data & Analytics und begleitest sie von der Entwicklung strategischer Lösungsansätze bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung. Du steuerst und führst Kundenprojekte eigenständig und verantwortest dabei Scope, Qualität, Zeitplan und Budget sowie die Koordination des Projektteams. Du analysierst fachliche Anforderungen, Prozesse und Daten und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden passende technische und fachliche Lösungen – von Datenplattformen und Data Warehouses bis hin zu Analytics- und AI-Lösungen. Du arbeitest hands-on in der Umsetzung mit und bringst deine Expertise beispielsweise bei Datenmodellen, Datenpipelines, Reports, Visualisierungen, KI-Agenten und intelligenten Automatisierungslösungen ein. Du leitest Workshops und Termine auf Kundenseite, moderierst Entscheidungsprozesse und stellst sicher, dass fachliche und technische Perspektiven zu tragfähigen Lösungen zusammengeführt werden. Du baust nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen auf, erkennst neue Herausforderungen und entwickelst daraus gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden weitere Beratungsansätze und Folgebeauftragungen. Du setzt moderne Technologien wie Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Power Platform, Azure, SQL, Snowflake oder Databricks gezielt in Kundenprojekten ein und entwickelst unsere Beratungsleistungen kontinuierlich weiter. Du übernimmst fachliche Führung und Coaching von Consultants und Senior Consultants und unterstützt sie dabei, ihre Kompetenzen und Verantwortung im Projekt weiterzuentwickeln. Du wirkst an der Weiterentwicklung unseres Data-&-Analytics-Geschäfts mit – beispielsweise durch die Entwicklung von Best Practices, Methoden und Angeboten sowie durch die Unterstützung bei Presales- und Akquise-Aktivitäten. Dein Profil Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Mathematik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung und bringst mehrere Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in der Beratung oder in Data & Analytics mit. Du verfügst über fundierte Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Umsetzung von Data-&-Analytics-Lösungen und kannst fachliche Anforderungen mit technischen Lösungen verbinden. Du hast Erfahrung in der Steuerung und Leitung von Kundenprojekten und verstehst es, Projekte hinsichtlich Scope, Qualität, Zeit und Budget erfolgreich zu managen. Du trittst gegenüber Kunden souverän und beratungsstark auf, kannst Workshops und Meetings auf Entscheider-Ebene führen und baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf. Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in Technologien wie SQL, Power BI, Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Data Engineering, Snowflake oder Databricks mit und hast Freude daran, moderne Technologien zielgerichtet einzusetzen. Du interessierst dich für Künstliche Intelligenz, Generative AI und AI Agents und hast idealerweise bereits Erfahrung darin, AI-Lösungen zu konzipieren oder in Kundenprojekten umzusetzen. Du denkst analytisch, strukturiert und unternehmerisch, erkennst Potenziale beim Kunden und kannst daraus konkrete Lösungen, neue Beratungsansätze und Folgegeschäft entwickeln. Du übernimmst gerne fachliche Führung und Mentoring und hast Freude daran, Consultants und Senior Consultants weiterzuentwickeln sowie Verantwortung im Team zu übernehmen. Du überzeugst durch Eigeninitiative, Kommunikationsstärke und Hands-on-Mentalität, arbeitest gerne an komplexen Fragestellungen und hast sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse sowie eine moderate Reisebereitschaft. Unser Angebot Gestalte Veränderung mit: Du kommst zu einem spannenden Zeitpunkt zu uns und hast die Möglichkeit, einen wegweisenden Veränderungsprozess aktiv mitzugestalten – mit viel Raum für deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung. Faire & attraktive Vergütung: Wir bieten dir ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket, das deine Qualifikation, Erfahrung und deinen Verantwortungsbereich berücksichtigt. Learning & Development: Mit der pmOne Academy begleiten wir dich von Anfang an mit einem individuellen Lernpfad und einem persönlichen L&D-Coach. Dazu kommen vielfältige Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Hybrid Work: Arbeite flexibel im Homeoffice und nutzen unser modern, zentral gelegenes Office für persönlichen Austausch und Zusammenarbeit im Team. Workation: Du möchtest Arbeit und Tapetenwechsel verbinden? Für einige Wochen im Jahr kannst du mobil aus dem europäischen Ausland arbeiten – auf Wunsch auch in Kombination mit deinem Urlaub. Gesundheit & Wellbeing: Deine Gesundheit ist uns wichtig. Wir unterstützen dein physisches und mentales Wohlbefinden unter anderem mit Zugang zu psychologischer Beratung und Coaching sowie einer großzügigen Bezuschussung sportlicher Aktivitäten. Come as you are: Bei uns zählt der Mensch. Wir leben eine wertschätzende und offene Unternehmenskultur mit flachen Hierarchien, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und gelebter Diversity. Family first & gemeinsam Spaß haben : Beruf und Privatleben sollen zusammenpassen. Deshalb finden wir bei persönlichen oder familiären Anliegen individuelle Lösungen. Und natürlich kommt auch der Spaß nicht zu kurz – bei Firmenevents, gemeinsamen Koch-Aktivitäten, in der Kaffeeküche oder einfach beim Feierabend mit dem Team. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Clinical Research Associate/ Clinical Research Associate II
description: <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Precision for Medicine is not your typical CRO. We are passionate about cultivating our culture and are proud to share extremely high CRA retention rates compared to industry averages.</p> <p>CRAs join us, love their jobs, and stay because of the amazing people and enjoyable quality of life. You will have a lower than average number of protocols, setting you up to be a protocol expert. Travel is reasonable and your work/life balance will benefit as a result. Most meaningfully - your voice will be heard. Working in a smaller CRO allows you to have influence and impact when it matters most and support from direct line management.</p> <p><strong>We are hiring a Senior Clinical Research Associate/ Clinical Research Associate II, this position will be fully home based working in the UK or Northern Ireland.&nbsp;&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>About you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You are calm, thoughtful, and responsive when things don’t go as planned.</li> <li>You are well-prepared, whether it be for an investigator meeting, site visit or project team update, always staying two steps ahead of the game.</li> <li>You find quick and creative ways of overcoming difficulties.</li> <li>You have an impeccable eye for detail.</li> <li>You identify potential study risks and propose solutions on how to mitigate them.</li> <li>You take responsibility in the quality and outcomes of your work.</li> <li>You are adept at handling conflict by using tried and true resolution strategies.</li> </ul> <p><strong>How we will keep you busy and support your growth:</strong></p> <p>You will monitor and own the progress of clinical studies at investigative sites and ensure that clinical studies are conducted, recorded, and reported per protocol, SOPs, ICH-GCP, and all applicable regulations and standards. You will coordinate all necessary activities required to set up and monitor a study (i.e., identify investigators; helping prepare regulatory submissions, conducting pre-study and initiation visits, etc.).</p> <p><strong>Qualifications:</strong></p> <p>Minimum Required:</p> <ul> <li>4-year college degree or equivalent experience</li> </ul> <p>Other Required:</p> <ul> <li>Candidates should ideally have more than 1 years CRA experience within the CRO or pharmaceutical industry.</li> <li>Oncology experience, early phase experience desirable although not essential.</li> <li>Availability for domestic travel including overnight stays, which may constitute up to approximately 50-60% travel commitment (international travel may be required for some senior level positions)</li> <li>Fluency in English</li> </ul> <p>Precision’s uniquely integrated offering enables the science of precision medicine by combining novel clinical trial designs, industry-leading operational and medical experts, advanced biomarker and data analytics solutions, and an unequivocal real passion for rare diseases and oncology.</p> <p>Precision medicine is revolutionizing the attack on cancer—and we are passionate about helping you harness its power. We strike tumors on a molecular level using biomarkers to link specific mutations to specific treatments. We combine deep science with deep data from advanced technological platforms, then layer on specialized expertise in the design and execution of targeted, adaptive clinical trials. Ultimately, we deliver robust insights that inform real-time decisions—and optimize the oncology development pathway.</p> <p>We invite you to learn more about our growing organization serving our clients that are researching groundbreaking cancer therapies. We strive to ensure employees feel appreciated for the contributions they make every single day. Recognized as a Leader in the GRC Market, LogicGate continues to further solidify its position as a best-in-class platform.</p> <p>At LogicGate, our people are the foundation of everything we do. We are committed to delivering an exceptional experience for our employees and our customers by empowering and enabling our people to take ownership, make an impact, and deliver their best work.</p></div><p><strong>Job Description</strong></p> <p>At LogicGate, we don't just show up at events — we build programs that move deals forward. As our first Global Field Marketing Manager based in the UK, you'll own the events and ecosystem engine that converts executive engagement into high-intent pipeline.</p> <p>This is a role for someone who thrives on building. You'll manage all logistical, operational and reporting aspects, and the execution of industry conferences, curated customer events/experiences, executive dinners, roundtables, Customer Advisory Board meetings, webinars, and regional field programs — and you'll be relentless about ensuring every activity maps directly to pipeline creation and deal acceleration.</p> <p>You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Marketing, and Product, to ensure our events are seamlessly integrated into our overall go-to-market strategy.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Event Strategy &amp; Management:</strong> Develop, plan, and execute a comprehensive calendar of field events, including trade shows, conferences, roadshows, executive dinners, Customer Advisory Board events, and webinars. Effectively communicate event strategies, results, and recommendations in key meetings.</li> <li><strong>Content &amp; Messaging Alignment:</strong> Partner with the content team to ensure event messaging, presentations, and collateral are compelling, on-brand, and tailored to the event's objectives and audience.</li> <li><strong>End-to-End-Execution:</strong> Lead full event lifecycle: strategy, planning, logistics, vendor coordination, team enablement, on-site activation, and post-event follow-up and reporting. Execute events as integrated marketing programs that reinforce our Intelligent Change Management narrative — never as standalone activities.</li> <li><strong>Identifying Opportunities:</strong> Collaborate with the Sales and Marketing to identify and prioritize target accounts for each event. Right now, our platform connects nearly one million assets worldwide, putting over 6GW of live load under our direct control. raw.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
raw.description:
We're making energy fair, clean, and simple for all using technology. 

Octopus Energy started with a bold idea: to build Britain’s first truly digital energy supplier. By combining world-class tech with brilliant humans who care deeply about customers and driving the renewable energy transition, we made it happen and in 2025, we became Britain’s largest energy supplier. 

Octopus Energy Group is a global energy transition collective. 10 businesses working across 4 continents to tackle energy transformation at nearly every front.

And we constantly push to make energy better. Tirelessly campaigning for fair protections for customers. And building innovative technologies that forge a path to a green energy system.

We’re made up of 10,000+ authentic, committed people working around the world on stuff you'd never expect. We're united by a shared goal: to drive the global green energy revolution. Read our Spotlight series to meet some of the team.

 

We are looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer to join our Flexibility team.

The Flexibility team was established in early 2026, and has been growing throughout the year. The team is focused on greenfield opportunities at the cutting edge of Octopus' flexibility strategy, and aims to enable rapid response to global flex opportunities.

They are building the next generation of products and tools to make energy more flexible. These include our flagship Intelligent Octopus product automating demand shift for 300,000 customers with electric cars, home batteries or smart heating devices, saving 2 million customers money through Saving Sessions and Free Electricity Sessions, and managing 568MW of large grid-scale batteries to balance the system. The team develops products that are used by millions of customers, helping boost renewables use and decarbonise energy systems worldwide.

We embrace flat hierarchies and an open, agile culture that fosters innovation, flexibility, and creativity. 

We don’t hang our personalities up with our coats and nor should you. At Octopus, we hire great people who get stuff done, all whilst being themselves.

If this sounds exciting, we’d love to chat.


What you'll do

  • Acting as the flexibility team’s first frontend engineer, establish the team’s frontend capability, lead the team’s frontend technical direction and represent the team to the cross-team community of frontend engineers

  • Build and own a diverse range of customer-facing user journeys, enabling customers to onboard, control, and analyse their low carbon tech

  • Build and own internal-facing interfaces for stakeholder-collaborators and experimental prototypes

  • Interface with established mobile teams by providing WebViews for emerging mobile customer journeys 

  • Collaborate with our internal design team to integrate our designs into the wider Octopus design system ‘Coral’

  • Carry out product discovery by working closely with our Product Manager and stakeholders from across the organisation

  • Build highly reusable interfaces that enable rapid response to new opportunities


    • What you'll have
  • 5+ years of experience with our stack (listed below)

  • Experience taking problems, rather than strict guidelines, and developing strong solutions

  • Confidence owning the development cycle (request, requirements gathering, technical proposal, technical execution, deployment and monitoring.)

  • Confidence tackling large-scale tasks individually

  • An empathetic approach to delegating work and collaborating with others

  • The ability to develop websites that meet strong accessibility guidelines

  • Experience building scalable, performant sites that handle high levels of traffic well

  • Desirable: energy domain knowledge


    • Our stack

  • React (required)

  • TypeScript (required)

  • Next.js on Vercel (desirable)

  • GraphQL w/ Tanstack Query (desirable)

  • React Testing Library & vitest and/or msw (desirable)

    • We have a preference for candidates who can work hybrid from our London office, but we're open to fully remote candidates (you do need to be based in the UK).


    Why else you'll love it here

    • Wondering what the salary for this role is? Just ask us! On a call with one of our recruiters it's something we always cover as we genuinely want to match your experience with the correct salary. The reason why we don't advertise is because we honestly have a degree of flexibility and would never want salary to be a reason why someone doesn't apply to Octopus - what's more important to us is finding the right octofit!
    • Octopus Energy Group is a unique culture. An organisation where people learn, decide, and build quicker. Where people work with autonomy, alongside a wide range of amazing co-owners, on projects that break new ground. We want your hard work to be rewarded with perks you actually care about! We were recently named the UK's top company to work for, and we ranked in the top ten in the Sunday Times Best Places to Work 2024. Our Group CEO, Greg has recorded a podcast about our culture and how we empower our people. We’ve also been placed in the top 10 companies for senior leadership
    • Visit our UK perks hub - Octopus Employee Benefits
     
    If this sounds like you then we'd love to hear from you, tell us what you care about, why Octopus feels right and most importantly, bring us the real you! Applying for jobs can be a bit scary so have a nose through some of our tips first 🚀

title: Senior Fire Investigator - Ireland
description: <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Company Overview</strong></p> <p>Throughout our worldwide network of experts, clients and communities, we are renowned for our leadership in fire protection engineering – a legacy of responsibility we have proudly upheld since 1939. Today, our expertise extends broadly across closely related security and risk-based fields – from accessibility consulting and risk analysis to process safety, forensic investigations, security risk consulting, emergency management, digital innovation and more.</p> <p>Our engineers and consultants collaborate to solve complex safety and security challenges, ensuring our clients can protect what matters most. For over 80 years, we have helped mitigate risks that threaten lives, property and reputations. Through technology, expertise and industry-leading research, we remain dedicated to our purpose of making our world safe, secure and resilient.</p> <p>At Jensen Hughes, we believe that creating and sustaining a culture of trust, integrity and professional growth starts with putting our people first. Our employees are our greatest strength, and we value the unique perspectives and talents they bring to our organization.&nbsp;</p> <p>Our wide range of Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organization, supporting career development and providing forums for individuals to share experiences on topics they're passionate about. Together, we are cultivating a connected culture where everyone has the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed together.</p> <p><strong>Job Overview</strong></p> <p>Jensen Hughes is a market leading forensic investigation company, comprised of highly experienced investigators committed to delivering technical excellence.&nbsp; Operating throughout the UK, Ireland and overseas, we investigate the origin and cause of fires and explosions and other accidents or failures on land and at sea. Our clients trust us to respond rapidly and deliver conclusive reports, robust evidence and expert testimony of the highest technical standard in courts throughout the world.</p> <p>A forensic investigation includes establishing the root cause of an event and determining the likelihood of a recovery from a third party or the repudiation of a claim on an insurance policy because the policyholder has failed to fulfil obligations under the contract of insurance.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Senior Fire Investigator to join our highly qualified team, based in Ireland.</p> <p>&nbsp;This role will involve:</p> <ul> <li>Attending incident scenes, documenting and collecting evidence, interviewing witnesses</li> <li>Acting as investigator in the investigation of the origin, cause and development of more complex cases</li> <li>Liaising with experts representing other interested parties</li> <li>Producing consistently high quality, detailed and accurate technical reports</li> <li>Providing expert witness evidence, where required</li> <li>Utilising Jensen Hughes’ case management system to record all case-related activity, in line with SLA requirements</li> <li>Attending joint examinations, utilising the skills of specialists where necessary</li> <li>Maintaining technical knowledge and skills through continuous professional development, by attending training courses, undertaking research and reference to scientific papers and developments in the field of fire and explosion investigation</li> <li>Attending marketing events, as required</li> <li>Produce and present articles/presentations for training or marketing purposes</li> <li>Represent Jensen Hughes at meetings/conferences as an ambassador for the company</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements and Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Candidates will have relevant experience and/or qualifications in the field of fire investigation, fire engineering, forensic science or other relevant discipline. Membership to a professional body would be advantageous but is not essential. Regardless of academic/professional background, practical experience is essential.</li> <li>The role requires strong analytical skills and the ability to apply scientific and systematic approaches to the forensic examination of incident scenes.</li> <li>Strong communication skills are essential, along with the ability to present accurate information in a clear and unambiguous manner, both verbally and in writing.&nbsp; Attention to detail, a flexible approach and an ability to form effective working relationships with colleagues and clients are key qualities for this position. You will be expected to be able to work independently with minimal supervision, albeit there will always be a support network of colleagues when assistance or guidance is required.</li> <li>This role requires frequent, often short notice, travel to scenes across Ireland and the UK. Some overseas travel may also be required. You must hold a current driving licence and, ideally, be a car owner.</li> </ul> <p>In return, we offer a competitive salary and performance-related bonus along with other benefits.&nbsp;</p> <p>#LI-MR1</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><strong>Jensen Hughes is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.</strong></em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>At Jensen Hughes, we embrace innovation and understand that people are increasingly using artificial intelligence (AI) tools like ChatGPT and other generative platforms to learn, prepare and communicate.&nbsp; We have provided some guidelines regarding the responsible use of AI in the recruitment process.&nbsp; Please click <strong><a href="https://www.jensenhughes.com/careers/responsible-use-of-ai-in-the-jensen-hughes-recruitment-process">here</a></strong> to review.</p> <p><br>The security of your personal data is important to us. Jensen Hughes has implemented reasonable physical, technical, and administrative security standards to protect personal data from loss, misuse, alteration, or destruction. We protect your personal data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, using security technologies and procedures, such as encryption and limited access. Only authorized individuals may access your personal data for the purpose for which it was collected, and these individuals receive training about the importance of protecting personal data.&nbsp; Jensen Hughes is committed to compliance with all relevant data privacy laws in all areas where we do business, including, but not limited to, the GDPR and the CCPA.&nbsp; Additionally, our service providers are contractually bound to maintain the confidentiality of personal data and may not use the information for any unauthorized purpose.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>*Policy on use of 3rd party recruiting agency for direct placements<br><br>Jensen Hughes will occasionally augment a recruiting search through agencies for certain positions when business conditions warrant. Jensen Hughes will not accept resumes, inquiries or proposals from recruiting agencies as an acceptable method to consider a candidate. 3rd party recruiting agencies must sign a standard Jensen Hughes agreement after being evaluated and accepted by a Human Resources or Talent Acquisition manager, or member of the talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and employees of Jensen Hughes are not authorized to accept resumes, engage in fee-based searches through recruiting firms or sign a search agreement. Please note this policy does not apply to “staffing firms” or firms that are involved with hiring temporary staff. Any recruiting agency interested in being considered may contact our recruiting team at jensenhughesrecruiting.com.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

  • Lead all visual communications for Client, acting as brand guardian across print, digital, social, and events — ensuring consistency, quality, and strategic alignment at every touchpoint

  • Build, mentor, and develop the in-house creative team — providing clear creative direction, constructive feedback, and ongoing coaching that elevates individual craft and collective output
  • Serve as the primary creative partner to senior Client stakeholders, including marketing leadership and firm partners, presenting creative strategy and executions with confidence and clarity at executive level
  • Oversee the production of high-quality communications tailored for professional services audiences — from thought leadership campaigns and pitches to events and digital content
  • Champion and evolve Client's brand system, keeping it contemporary, distinctive, and appropriate for a regulated sector environment

  • Collaborate with OLIVER's wider creative and account leadership to identify opportunities to grow the studio's offering and deepen the Client relationship
  • Oversee studio-level production budgets — including cost estimation, supplier relationships, and spend reporting — ensuring financial performance aligns with Client and OLIVER expectations
  • Drive responsible integration of AI tools across studio workflows, setting quality standards and governance that preserve craft excellence while improving efficiency 

What you need to be great in this role: 

  • A strong portfolio of sophisticated brand and campaign work, with particular depth in B2B, corporate, or professional services environments
  • Expert-level understanding of brand systems — how to build, maintain, and evolve them within complex, regulated contexts
  • A track record of leading and developing creative teams, with a coaching approach that brings out the best in people at all levels

  • Deep craft knowledge across print and digital — typography, layout, art direction, and visual storytelling — with the ability to contribute hands-on when the work demands it

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving.   • 5+ years in content design or UX writing, with a portfolio that shows work on both sides: copy shipped inside a product, and marketing pages you wrote or restructured

  • Real in-product examples. Onboarding flows, empty states, error messaging, upgrade moments - the words people hit when something is confusing or has gone wrong. Tell us what changed as a result

  • Real web examples. Pages where the copy carries the argument, not just the headline.

  • Own the copy in the moments that decide whether someone sticks: first run in the editor, empty states, failed and partial builds, upgrade and credit prompts

  1. Fill in a short form then jump on an intro call with a recruiter.

description: About Deliveroo Our mission is to transform the way people shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of one of the most rapidly expanding industries in the world: a complex, always-on, three-sided marketplace that impacts millions of people every day. Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. The Team BizOps is the team that keeps its finger on the pulse of business performance: continuously, rigorously, and across multiple dimensions at once. We turn raw operational and financial data into actionable intelligence, surfacing what is happening, why it is happening, and what to expect next , for the operators, executives, and functional teams who run the business day to day. We are not a reporting function that produces outputs on request. We work continuously, proactively watching, delivering, and questioning whether the signal is real, acting as "first responders" to surprising deviations from expectation and using what we learn to drive faster, better decision-making for the business at large. Our work spans the full stack of analytics: from the warehouse models that make metrics trustworthy, to the monitoring systems that catch problems early, to the reports and dashboards that make performance visible, to the deep-dive investigations that explain what the numbers mean and what we should do about it. We anchor our analysis to the right reference points: how performance compares to plan, to prior periods, and to what we'd expect, and we bring causal rigour when the business needs to know whether an action actually worked. The culture within the team is informal, fast-paced and entrepreneurial. Given the growth of the business and the level of senior stakeholder exposure, progression in the team can be fast. The Role Deliveroo is hiring a Senior Data Scientist to join BizOps, based in our London HQ (hybrid, minimum three days per week in the office). This role is largely project-based: starting from a strategic or performance question, you'll combine data, business context, and structured problem-solving to provide the insights that drive decision-making at a global level with senior stakeholders. You will own delivery end-to-end, from the messy, ambiguous question to a rigorous, trustworthy, and actionable answer. You'll be equally comfortable building the systems that make performance visible and going deep on the investigations that explain it. One week you might diagnose why a key market has moved away from plan; the next, identify the drivers behind a change in customer or operational performance; the next, build monitoring that helps teams spot and understand emerging issues earlier. Success in this role requires building effective working relationships across Deliveroo, particularly with international markets, as well as the Data Science, Operations, Commercial, and Finance teams. Deconstruct broad, ambiguous problem spaces into structured analytical roadmaps, and understand how your work intersects with adjacent systems and teams. Build for scale, not one-offs. Build the pipelines, models, dashboards, monitoring, and investigative tooling that make performance visible and reliable. Automate wherever possible; redoing analyses by hand is slow and error-prone. Measure impact with discipline. Design measurement strategies from simple A/B tests to quasi-experimental designs (synthetic control, difference-in-differences, event studies) when trials aren't feasible, always with conservative, assumption-explicit language. Be a first responder. Surface deviations before they become escalations, and be just as willing to give the confident "this is noise, no action needed" as the alarm. Communicate to influence. Translate complex findings into clear, simple, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences that shape roadmaps and decisions. Raise the bar. Contribute to the broader Analytics community, improve shared approaches and best practices, and help build data literacy across the business. What You'll Need to Thrive Our ideal candidate brings strong expertise in some of these areas and the curiosity to grow in others: Experience in an analytical or data science role, such as data analytics, data science, forecasting, planning, strategy analytics, or a similar discipline. Experience in logistics, e-commerce, marketplaces, or another fast-moving, customer-focused business is useful but not essential. Proficiency with SQL and a scripting language such as Python or R, alongside experience with BI or visualisation tooling such as Looker, Tableau, or similar. Comfortable using modern AI-assisted tools to work efficiently while maintaining high standards of accuracy and reproducibility. A pragmatic approach to problem-solving: you can balance analytical rigour with speed, adapt your approach to the importance of the decision, and focus effort where it will have the greatest impact. Effective problem-solving: you can take an ambiguous question, identify the underlying problem or decision, develop hypotheses, and use data and business context to reach a clear point of view. Experience with experimentation and/or causal inference is a strong plus: the ability to unpick insights and steer strategic decisions. Excellent communication skills, in person, in writing, and in code, with the ability to translate business needs into analytical problems and complex findings into simple recommendations. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

About the Role

We're building out a dedicated Governance, Risk & Compliance function — moving from a mix of individual ownership and external consultancy support to a resourced team that scales with the business.
